name: au-forex-gains-losses
description: Use this guide for Australian foreign currency gains and losses under Division 775 of the ITAA 1997. It covers realised foreign exchange amounts, foreign currency bank accounts and the treatment of crypto assets such as stablecoins within the stated scope. Use it when an accountant needs to establish the relevant transaction, source rule, timing and supporting records before preparing a computation. The method, client questions and refusal conditions must be read together. Confirm the applicable period and cited provisions before relying on a result, and refer unresolved classifications for qualified review.
